title: 3.2.0.1 new APK res/q-.apk duplicates many files in res/
body:
This is a Hedgehog fullRelease build of aeed6e208393a6dd0c43c58c17a2529f6a646de4

The new APK seems to be a complete version of the res/ directory with some changes.  It more than doubles the disk size of the res directory itself and results in about 10MByte more in the 3.2.0.1 APK compared with 3.2.0-rc2 and previous releases.  From AndroidStudio analysis/guesstimates:

3.2.0-rc2: APK size: 55 MB, Download Size: 20.9 MB
3.2.0.1: APK size: 66.2 MB, Download Size: 30.5 MB

So it may also increase the download size by 50%, though that's not relevant in practice.

comments.body: no idea where is this coming from

Here (from the new StudioProjects directory I constructed and used to build 3.2.0 a couple of day ago):

```
jbowler@hippopopus ~/StudioProjects/AndroidAPS-3.2 $ sh -x ../ttt
+ find . -type f -print0
+ xargs -0 md5sum
+ egrep 7ee9d9e80f9d664ca73bfe72f18ce53f
7ee9d9e80f9d664ca73bfe72f18ce53f  ./app/build/intermediates/packaged_res/fullRelease/raw/android_wear_micro_apk.apk
7ee9d9e80f9d664ca73bfe72f18ce53f  ./app/build/generated/res/microapk/full/release/raw/android_wear_micro_apk.apk
```

It's not in the git source (I checked in the same way) but somehow the build now puts a, for me, spurious APK into the resources.

![image](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/11146458/994df32c-9248-4a4b-b136-83ba0f483021)
q-.apk  is wear apk but I don't understand why it's included when it's not possible to install it to watch
these files do the size of final apk

That's it.  SteamPunk.zip also appears to be watch related ("CustomWatchface.png" for example).  I don't know how to check the signature on q-.apk but that might give a clue.  Also the build log presumably shows what built it (I don't know enough AndroidStudio to even find the build log.)
the change between rc2 and 3.2.0.1 is migration to kts builds. maybe there is something different. but i didn't find a option how to affect it
